dhp146:1: Why this laughter, why this joy,
dhp146:2: when the world is constantly burning,
dhp146:4: do you not seek for a light?
dhp147:2: a heap of sores that is raised up,

dhp148:3: the putrid body comes to destruction,
dhp149:1: Like discarded white gourds thrown away in autumn
dhp149:3: are these grey bones; seeing them,
dhp150:1: This fortress is made out of bones,
dhp150:2: plastered over with flesh and blood,
dhp150:3: but hidden within lie old age,
dhp151:3: but the good Dhamma does not decay,
dhp151:4: the good surely pass it on to the good.
dhp152:2: increases in age like an ox,
dhp153:1: Through the round of countless births and deaths
dhp154:1: O housebuilder, now you are seen!
dhp154:2: You will not build the house again:
dhp154:3: all your rafters have been broken,
dhp154:4: and the ridgepole has been destroyed,
dhp154:5: my mind has reached the unconditioned,
dhp154:6: and craving’s end has been achieved.
dhp155:1: Not having lived the holy life,

dhp156:1: Not having lived the holy life,
